A '''refrigeration unit''' was a type of [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling unit]]. The [[Emperor-4 beam tube]]'s power system included a small refrigeration unit attached to the [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]]. The unit was designed to keep the power cell operating in a safe temperature range during operation.<ref name="EGWT" />
